short_description: A countdown to the next rocket launch, with a rocket waiting on its pad.
description:
## What you see

- On the front: a rocket on its pad and the time to liftoff in large digits, such as 02:13:44, or 3D 07H when it is days away. The color follows the launch status: green for Go, yellow for TBC or TBD, red for Hold.
- At T-0 the rocket lifts off with a roar, and the next launch takes its place.
- On the back display: the mission name, its status, the launch time and which of the upcoming launches it is.

## How to use

Turn the wheel to step through the upcoming launches, up to five.

## Data

[The Space Devs Launch Library 2](https://thespacedevs.com/llapi), no key needed, checked every 15 minutes. Without a connection the app keeps counting down to the launches it last got, dimmed, with a red cross in the corner.
changelog: First release: up to five upcoming launches, a rocket that lifts off at T-0 with a sound, details on the back display, the last list kept without a connection.
